verdict.rationale: Docusign's core eSignature functionality (send, sign, manage envelopes, templates) is fully exposed via a documented REST API and official SDKs (docusign-docs-21, docusign-docs-38, docusign-gh-1/2/3), and community feedback confirms the API covers the vast majority of use cases (docusign-comm-3). However, several newer AI-powered UI capabilities—Web Forms drag-and-drop builder, CLM's workflow drag-and-drop editor, and AI-Assisted Review's Word plugin/playbook builder—are explicitly marketed as no-code/UI-first tools (docusign-docs-17/18/28/44) with no evidence of equivalent API endpoints, and one community report notes the API only covers ~95% of use cases with real workarounds needed (docusign-comm-3, docusign-comm-5/7 on documentation gaps). missing for 10: API parity evidence for Web Forms builder, CLM workflow designer, and AI-Assisted Review Word integration; independent confirmation that 100% of UI actions are scriptable.
